name: actrouter
description: Routes work to the right model: routes each of your prompts and every subagent automatically, and recommends models for LLM-calling code you write.

api_key.title: ActRouter API key
api_key.description: Your ActRouter API key (starts with ar_live_). Routing runs on the hosted ActRouter API, which needs it.

router_url.title: ActRouter URL (advanced)
router_url.description: Leave empty for the hosted ActRouter API. Set it only for a dedicated deployment you were given. The first 600 characters of each prompt are sent to the API for routing (prompt_routing off sends none).

subagent_routing.title: Automatic subagent routing
subagent_routing.description: on: pick a model for every subagent started without one. off: only route when asked (MCP tools).

prompt_routing.title: Prompt routing
prompt_routing.description: What to do when your prompt fits another model than the session's. delegate: Claude does substantial work on that model through a subagent. advise: only tell you (/model switches). off: do not route prompts.

preference.title: Routing preference
preference.description: How automatic prompt and subagent routing trades quality against cost: quality, balanced or cost.

baseline_model.title: Baseline model
baseline_model.description: The model your subagents would use without ActRouter, for measuring savings (e.g. sonnet). Leave empty to detect it: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, the subagent's definition, else this session's model.

ledger.title: Routing ledger
ledger.description: File that records routing decisions and their outcomes (no prompts or task text), for `actrouter-route report`. Leave empty for ~/.actrouter/routing-ledger.jsonl, or set off.
